sentence: Tidy up the backyard, it just needs a light clean.

evidence.note: Wooden fence includes one lighter-colored panel that may be a secondary gate/door, but its width can't be judged from this angle.

observation.model_notes: Photo 1 and Photo 2 appear to show two visually distinct spaces: Photo 1 is an American-style backyard with a storage shed, raised deck and pool. Photo 2 is a small enclosed paved courtyard against a brick outbuilding with a wooden privacy fence, in what looks like a different architectural context. Both were labeled backyard on the assumption they belong to the same property per the customer's request, but this should be confirmed before scoping, since they may represent different areas or even be mismatched photos.

evidence.note: Lawn is mowed with visible mower stripes, no debris or overgrowth visible around shed, deck, or fence line.
Scattered dried leaves across the paver patio and a few small weeds sprouting between paver joints and in the gravel patch; grass area has some seed heads/small yellow-flowered weeds mixed in.
